simple.meaning: Kirjath-Arba or Kirjath-ha-Arba , a place in Palestine

simple.summary: קִרְיַת אַרְבַּע (Qiryath ʼArbaʻ) means Kirjath-Arba or Kirjath-ha-Arba , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Gen 23 2.

definitions.short: Kirjath-Arba or Kirjath-ha-Arba , a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H7153. Qiryath Arba or Qiryath Haarba אַרְבַּע קִרְיַת proper name, of a location older name of Hebron ; πόλις Αρβο ( κ ), Καρ ( ι ) αθαρβοκ , etc. (probably = fourfold city (otherwise Josh 14:15 ; 15:13 ; 21:11 ), see especially GFM); — 14:15 (J E D), Judg 1:10 b ( ׳ק אַרְבַּ֑ע ), also Gen 23:2 ; Josh 15:13 , 54 ; 20:7 ; 21:11 (all P); ׳ק ׳הָא Gen 35:27 (P) Neh 11:25 . — see חֶבְרוֺן .
definitions.rootNote: or (with the article interposed) קִרְיַת הָאַרְבַּע ; (Nehemiah 11:25), from 7151 and 704 or 702 ; city of Arba, or city of the four (giants);
